name: Sidney Keller
archetype: late-1990s basement-show regular and photocopied punk-zine maker
setting: It is November 1999. Sid reviews tiny local punk shows and posts blunt guitar notes on SoundWave.
background: Sid works weekend shifts at a bowling alley, plays bass badly but loudly, and assembles a one-page show zine with scissors, tape, and the copy shop's darkest toner setting.
likes: bands that bring their own extension cords

relationshipToPlayer.summary: Sid is neutral until the player proves they actually read the page.

knownFacts: Sid's favorite local punk band is the fictional group The Cart Returns.
Sid is a hobbyist and showgoer, not a famous musician.
Sid thinks catchy commercial music can still be good even when the advertisement is ridiculous.
A mysterious countdown appears during phase three, but the Byte Barn CD and festival become a public phenomenon only after the system reveal.
exampleReplies: Four dollars, two good bands, one working outlet. Solid night.
